ROUND ONE BOXING

TERMS &
CONDITIONS.

Last updated: 4 October 2026

1. About these terms

These terms cover the Round One Boxing website, boxing equipment orders, Private Home Boxing Training in Salisbury Heights, South Australia, and Online Boxing Coaching. Contact Round One through our Contact page with questions, order issues or booking requests.

Read these terms before placing an order or confirming a booking. The terms in place when your order or booking is confirmed apply to that transaction. Later changes do not retrospectively reduce your rights.

2. Your Australian Consumer Law rights

Nothing in these terms excludes, restricts or modifies a consumer guarantee or other right or remedy that cannot lawfully be excluded under the Australian Consumer Law.

Goods must meet applicable guarantees, including acceptable quality, matching their description and fitness for a purpose made known to us. Services must be provided with due care and skill, be fit for an agreed purpose and be delivered within a reasonable time if no time is agreed.

For a major failure with goods, you may choose a refund or replacement. For a major service failure, you may cancel and obtain a refund for the unused portion, or keep the contract and seek compensation for reduced value. Other failures must be remedied within a reasonable time; further remedies apply if they are not. Compensation for reasonably foreseeable loss or damage may also be available.

These rights are separate from any manufacturer warranty and are not limited by an arbitrary return deadline. See the ACCC consumer guarantees guidance.

3. Prices, orders and payment

All prices are in Australian dollars (AUD). The displayed consumer price includes any applicable GST. Check the product, colour, size or variant, quantity, delivery details and final total before paying. A customer phone number is required for order and delivery enquiries.

Equipment payments are processed by Stripe or PayPal. A return to the website alone is not proof of successful payment: payment status is checked with the payment provider. Keep your order reference and payment receipt.

If we cannot supply an item or identify an error affecting your order, we will contact you to arrange an agreed alternative or a refund of the affected amount. We will not charge an additional amount or substitute an item without your agreement.

4. Australian delivery

Equipment delivery is available within Australia only, with free shipping. Provide a complete, accurate Australian delivery address and tell us promptly if it needs correction.

Delivery estimates, when provided, are estimates rather than guaranteed dates. Contact us if an order is delayed, damaged, incomplete or lost. We will help resolve delivery issues; using a carrier does not remove our responsibilities under Australian Consumer Law.

5. Problems, returns and refunds

Contact us with your order reference or other reasonable proof of purchase and a description of the issue. Photographs may help where practical. We may reasonably assess the issue, but you do not have to pursue a manufacturer instead of dealing with us.

For a confirmed faulty product, we cover reasonable return costs. Contact us before returning bulky equipment so suitable collection or return arrangements can be made. Original packaging is not a condition of exercising consumer guarantee rights.

A change of mind is different from a faulty or incorrectly supplied item. Ask us about a change-of-mind return before sending goods back; any discretionary return arrangement will be agreed with you. This does not limit your statutory remedies. See the ACCC guidance on remedies.

6. Personal training and bookings

Private Home Boxing Training: $60 AUD per hour.
Online Boxing Coaching: $60 AUD per hour.

Submitting an enquiry requests a session; it does not guarantee a time or create a confirmed booking. The session time, duration, format and total price are agreed before booking. Private sessions are held at the coach’s home training space in Salisbury Heights. Location details are provided privately when arrangements are confirmed.

Online clients need a suitable device, reliable internet and clear space to move. The video platform and joining details will be agreed before the session. No particular fitness, weight-loss or competitive outcome is guaranteed.

Tell us promptly if you need to change or cancel. Any cancellation conditions or fees must be disclosed and agreed before the booking and must comply with consumer law. These terms impose no automatic cancellation fee. If we cancel and cannot agree a replacement session, any payment for the unprovided session will be refunded.

7. Training safety

Follow coaching instructions, use equipment appropriately and stop if you feel unwell or experience pain. Tell the coach about relevant limitations before training; seek appropriate health advice if you are unsure whether participation is suitable. Share only information needed to plan a safe session.

For a participant under 18, a parent or guardian must contact us to discuss suitability and supervision before any booking is accepted. These terms do not waive liability for negligence or remove non-excludable consumer rights.

8. Website use and privacy

Use the website lawfully and do not interfere with its security or other users. Website text, branding and images belong to their respective owners; permission is needed for reuse beyond what the law allows. External providers have their own terms, which do not replace your rights against Round One.

Our Privacy Policy explains how order, enquiry and training information is handled.

9. Questions and disputes

Please contact us first so we can consider the issue and work towards a fair resolution. You can also seek assistance from Consumer and Business Services South Australia, a relevant consumer agency, tribunal or court.

South Australian law applies, together with applicable Australian law. This does not remove mandatory protections in your location or prevent you bringing a claim in a court or tribunal with jurisdiction.
